the project was extended for this component.The project had set a target to provide 53117 hectares ha of land with irrigation water and related services by the end of project. The overall target is comprised of three different types of irrigation investments i new schemes 15239 ha4 ii rehabilitation and upgrading or improvement of existing schemes 31185 ha5 and iii microirrigation and household irrigation MHHI systems 6693 ha. To date the project has provided 58823 hectares of land with irrigation and water related services surpassing the end of project target of 53117 hectares. The completed works have benefited 157894 households including 32235 femaleheaded households.7 With regards to new SSI schemes 10476 hectares have been completed achieving 69 of the target which is an improvement from the 57 achievement during the last mission in May 2023. With regards to rehabilitationupgrading for existing schemes 29149 hectares has been completed meeting 93.5 of the target compared with 90 of the prior mission. With regards to MHHI systems the project has completed 19199 hectares which is 287 of the target compared with 273 in the previous mission.
